digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, EXECUTION-phase Pass-2 finding veto
propositions: During execution-phase re-review, Pass-1 finders flag plan-vs-code discrepancies as false positives when the discrepancy is the intended result of the plan's already-completed directed work.

A new binary sub-answer `current_state_satisfies_plan_goal` (na-default, outside GRADED_BINARY) must be added to the plan-review verification model and checked by the verifier via present-state code inspection.
Pass-2 must drop findings with `reason="veto:plan-goal-satisfied"` only when `execution_review=True` AND the answer is definite `yes` AND the finding's criteria are in `registry.CODEBASE_GROUNDED`.

The veto is cohort-restricted to CODEBASE_GROUNDED (E4/G1G2/A1/G6) via deterministic enforcement in `orchestrator.pass3_over_findings` (_restrict_on_target_veto_to_grounded forces non-grounded answers to na).
Planning-phase reviews must preserve the same findings unvetoed (execution_review=False by default preserves all findings).
Answers `no`, `insufficient`, `na`, or an absent key must NOT fire the veto under execution_review=True.
